title: refactor(GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta/Heights/HilbertSamuel): deduplicate resolution metric pair and pullback constructions
body:
Generalize the resolution-atlas, line-bundle, weight, smooth-volume, section, and Bergman-density integral helpers in `PBlockResolutionMetricPair.lean` from `HSMBlockDatum` to any analytic resolution `AnRes P J D` (with `sec` polymorphic in the coefficient ring), and factor out the shared finite neighborhood cover (`exists_finite_nbhd_cover`) and Bergman-density integral comparison (`bergmanDens_integral_eq`).

Rewrite `ResolutionMetricPair.proof` (via `HermLine.ofCone`) and `ResolutionPullback.proof` to reuse these shared helpers directly, removing the duplicate constructions.

Removed unused declarations in `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.ResolutionMetricPair`:
- `refine`, `mem_refine_source`, `mem_refine_target`, `refine_compatible`, `lintegral_chart`
- `blockRatio`, `blockRatio_eq`, `blockRatio_eq_div`, `isConeTangent_of_map`, `levi_const_mul`
- `nbhd`, `isOpen_nbhd`, `mem_nbhd`, `atlas`, `mem_atlas_source`, `mem_atlas_target`, `sameOrbit_lift`, `lift_mem`, `analyticAt_lift`, `torus_eq_smul`
- `bundle`, `contDiffAt_weight`, `weight`, `weight_isSemipositive`, `smoothVol`, `sec`, `sec_apply_of_mem`, `sec_mem`, `lift_chartIdx`, `locDens_eq_chernTopDens`

Removed unused declarations in `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.ResolutionPullback`:
- `refine`, `mem_refine_source`, `mem_refine_target`, `refine_compatible`, `lintegral_chart`
- `eval_torus`, `prod_norm_unitDeg`, `isOpen_blockNonzero`, `blockRatio`, `blockRatio_eq`, `blockRatio_eq_div`
- `nbhd`, `isOpen_nbhd`, `mem_nbhd`, `atlas`, `mem_atlas_source`, `mem_atlas_target`, `sameOrbit_lift`, `lift_mem`, `analyticAt_lift`
- `bundle`, `contDiffAt_weight`, `weight`, `weight_isSemipositive`, `smoothVol`, `sec`, `sec_apply_of_mem`, `sec_mem`, `ptNormSq_sec`
